title: Food affordability and the household burden of health spending in Türkiye: analysis code, analysis plan and aggregated outputs (ILCS/EU-SILC 2023–2025)
description: Analysis code (R 4.6.1, Python 3.13), the written analysis plan (with its departures) and all aggregated outputs (tables, figures, machine-readable results) for the manuscript Food affordability and the household burden of health spending in Türkiye by Salim Yılmaz and Ahmet Murat Günal, submitted to Foods (MDPI). The study analyzes the 2023–2025 cross-sections of the Income and Living Conditions Survey of the Turkish Statistical Institute (TurkStat). The microdata are not included: they are released by TurkStat under a microdata user agreement and cannot be redistributed (Statistical Law No. 5429, Articles 13 and 14).

creators.name: Yılmaz, Salim
creators.affiliation: Acıbadem Mehmet Ali Aydınlar University, Istanbul, Türkiye

notes: Version 1.0.0 corresponds to the manuscript as submitted. The TurkStat microdata are not part of this archive.
